program_narrative: Program HISTLD00 is a batch program that loads transaction history records into the DB2 table POSHIST. It opens the indexed file TRANSACTION-HISTORY for sequential input and the batch control file BATCH-CONTROL-FILE for update, connects to DB2 (through CONNECT-TO-DB2, which is not part of this program), reads the job's control record (key job name 'HISTLD00') and marks it active. The main loop reads history records one by one until end of file or until more than 100 load errors; for each record it copies 13 transaction fields into POSHIST-RECORD and inserts a row, counting rows written and errors, and silently skipping duplicate-key rows (SQLCODE -803). Every 1000 records it commits the DB2 work, resets the commit counter and rewrites the control record with the read/written counts as a checkpoint. At the end it commits, writes a final checkpoint, closes both files, disconnects from DB2, displays the read/written/error counts and returns the error count as the program return code. Error conditions handled: file open failures, missing control record, checkpoint rewrite failure (all via 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE, which calls ERRPROC and rolls back DB2 work but does not stop the run) and INSERT failures (via DB2-ERROR-ROUTINE, not traceable here). The source field names of the history mapping (TH-*) and the checkpoint counters are not declared, so those data movements cannot be fully traced.
